narration: You ran every number before buying your home — the mortgage, the taxes, the insurance. But there's one bill missing from every spreadsheet, and it's a lot.
visual: House SVG rising from bottom of dark screen. Paper checklist showing 'mortgage', 'taxes', 'insurance' with checkmarks. Then an orange warning badge springs in: 'BUT MISSED ONE BIG BILL'.

narration: Financial experts call it the one percent rule — budget one percent of your home's value every single year just for maintenance. On a $450,000 home, that's $4,500 every year.
visual: Light background. House SVG with a bold '1%' badge. Animated counter climbing from $0 to $4,500. Label: 'EVERY YEAR'. Small caption: 'on a $450K home'.

narration: And the repairs are real. A roof replacement runs eight to fifteen thousand dollars. Your HVAC goes out — that's ten to twelve thousand. Water heater failure? Another fifteen hundred to thirty-five hundred.
visual: Dark background. Three repair cards slide in from the left: roof SVG with '$8K–$15K', HVAC unit SVG with '$10K–$12K', water heater SVG with '$1.5K–$3.5K'. Each springs in one after another.

narration: Run the math over twenty years and you're looking at ninety thousand dollars — and that's before any structural issue, flooded basement, or full electrical overhaul.
visual: Light background. Year counter climbing 0 to 20. Progress bar filling. Dollar counter running from $0 up to $90,000 in orange. Label: 'BEFORE ANY MAJOR EMERGENCY'.

narration: Here's the wild part — sixty-four percent of homeowners say they were completely blindsided by repair costs. Banks don't tell you. Agents don't tell you. The inspection buries it on page forty-seven.
visual: Dark background. Animated pie chart filling to 64% in orange. Center label '64% UNPREPARED'. Stacked text cards fade in: 'BANKS DON'T TELL YOU', 'AGENTS DON'T TELL YOU', 'THE INSPECTION BURIES IT'.

narration: Here's the fix: open a separate savings account today and auto-transfer $375 every month. That's one percent of a $450K home divided by twelve. Pay your house a salary before it sends you a surprise bill. Follow for more traps buyers miss.
visual: Light background. Piggy bank SVG with animated coin dropping in. Steps fading in: 'OPEN A SEPARATE ACCOUNT', 'SET AN AUTO-TRANSFER'. Then large orange badge springs in: '$375 EVERY MONTH'. CTA: 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY TRAPS'.
